reviews.text: I really love this hand cream! It has a lovely lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving my hands greasy or sticky. My hands feel soft and moisturized, and I love how comfortable it is to use throughout the day. The packaging is also simple and beautiful. Definitely one I’ll keep reaching for!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款護手霜！質地輕盈可愛，吸收快，唔會令手油膩或者黏黏地。雙手感覺柔軟、水潤，成日都用得好舒服。包裝又簡約又靚。我一定會一直用返佢！

reviews.text: This hand cream has been really nice to use, especially when my hands feel dry. It has a smooth texture that spreads easily and absorbs pretty quickly without leaving my hands feeling too sticky or greasy. I also really like the small size because I can easily carry it in my bag and use it throughout the day. It leaves my hands feeling soft and moisturized, and overall I’m really happy with it!
reviews.zh: 呢款護手霜用起嚟好好，尤其係雙手乾嗰陣。質地順滑、易推開，吸收幾快，唔會令手太黏或者油膩。我都好鍾意細細個嘅 size，因為好容易放喺袋入面，全日都可以用。用完雙手柔軟、水潤，整體我好滿意！

reviews.text: This birch juice hand cream surprised me in a good way. The texture is light, absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any greasy feeling. The scent is fresh and clean, perfect for everyday use. It keeps my hands soft for hours and the packaging is cute and easy to carry. I would definitely buy it again.
reviews.zh: 呢款樺樹汁護手霜令我有驚喜。質地輕盈，吸收快，冇油膩感。香味清新乾淨，日常用好啱。雙手可以柔軟好幾個鐘，包裝又可愛，方便攜帶。我一定會再買。

reviews.text: I have always wanted to try a product from round lab and i managed to get their hand cream. First of all the packaging is very lovely and the scent is so fragrant but not too strong. It keeps my hand soft and hydrated. I have purchased two of these and am very satisfied with the product. I am looking forward to purchasing more items from this brand.
reviews.zh: 我一直都好想試吓 Round Lab 嘅產品，終於攞到佢哋嘅護手霜。首先包裝好靚，香味好香但唔會太濃。雙手保持柔軟、水潤。我已經買咗兩支，對產品好滿意。我期待會再買呢個品牌嘅其他產品。

reviews.text: If you love the famous Round Lab Birch Juice sunscreen, you are going to adore this hand cream. It has a gorgeous, lightweight gel-cream texture that sinks into the skin almost instantly. There is zero greasy or sticky residue left behind, which means you can type on your phone or keyboard right after applying without leaving smudges. It leaves hands feeling instantly soft, smooth, and deeply hydrated all day long. Plus, it's virtually fragrance-free, making it a dream for sensitive noses or anyone who hates heavy scents. Absolute handbag essential!
reviews.zh: 如果你鍾意出名嘅 Round Lab 樺樹汁防曬，你一定會好愛呢款護手霜。質地好靚，係輕盈嘅啫喱奶霜，幾乎即時滲入皮膚。冇任何油膩或者黏膩殘留，所以搽完即可以打手機或者鍵盤，唔會留低指印。全日雙手都即時柔軟、順滑、深層水潤。而且幾乎冇香味，對敏感嗅覺或者唔鍾意濃烈香味嘅人嚟講係一個福音。絕對係手袋必備！

reviews.text: I really like this hand cream! It has a smooth, lightweight texture and absorbs nicely without leaving my hands feeling greasy. It leaves my skin feeling soft, moisturized, and comfortable. Perfect for keeping in my bag and using throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款護手霜！質地順滑、輕盈，吸收好好，唔會令手油膩。用完皮膚感覺柔軟、水潤、舒適。好啱放喺袋入面，全日都可以用。

reviews.text: I struggle with finding a good hand cream, as I get sensory issues when feeling specific consistencies on my hands - this hand cream doesn’t do it to me! it hydrates my hands really good without leaving them feeling sticky. it’s also a perfect size for even a really small bag so it comes everywhere with me!
reviews.zh: 我好難搵到好嘅護手霜，因為我手上接觸某啲質地時會有感官不適——呢款護手霜冇呢個問題！好好咁補濕雙手，又唔會令手黏黏地。size 好啱，就算好細嘅袋都放得落，所以我去邊都帶住佢！

reviews.text: I’ve been using this hand cream and it’s perfect for keeping my hands soft and moisturized. It deeply hydrates without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling, which I really appreciate. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it great for everyday use. My hands feel smooth and nourished all day long.
reviews.zh: 我一直都用緊呢款護手霜，好適合保持雙手柔軟同水潤。佢深層補濕，唔會有黏膩或者油膩感，我好欣賞。質地輕盈，吸收快，日常用好好。全日雙手都感覺順滑、滋潤。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
